original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    otel_collector_version: "0.92.0"
    otel_remote_endpoint: "https://your-remote-endpoint.com:443"
    otel_remote_headers: {}
    otel_service_name: "otelcol"
    otel_user: "otelcol"
    otel_group: "otelcol"
    otel_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol"
    otel_binary_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol"
    otel_systemd_unit: "/etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service"
  tasks:
    - name: Create OpenTelemetry system group
      group:
        name: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: yes
        state: present

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry system user
      user:
        name: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: yes
        shell: "/usr/sbin/nologin"
        home: "{{ otel_config_dir }}"
        create_home: no
        state: present

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry config directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_collector_version }}/otelcol_{{ otel_collector_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol_{{ otel_collector_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
        mode: '0644'
        checksum: "sha256:https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_collector_version }}/otelcol_{{ otel_collector_version }}_checksums.txt"

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol_{{ otel_collector_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp"
        remote_src: yes

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      copy:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol-linux-amd64"
        dest: "{{ otel_binary_path }}"
        mode: '0755'
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      template:
        src: otelcol-config.yaml.j2
        dest: "{{ otel_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: '0644'
      notify: Restart OpenTelemetry Collector

    - name: Create systemd service unit
      template:
        src: otelcol.service.j2
        dest: "{{ otel_systemd_unit }}"
        mode: '0644'
      notify: Reload systemd and restart OpenTelemetry Collector

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector service
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_service_name }}"
        enabled: yes
        state: started
        daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
    - name: Restart OpenTelemetry Collector
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_service_name }}"
        state: restarted

    - name: Reload systemd and restart OpenTelemetry Collector
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: yes

  templates:
    - src: otelcol-config.yaml.j2
      dest: "{{ otel_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
    - src: otelcol.service.j2
      dest: "{{ otel_systemd_unit }}"
